test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. One of them contains an error. Select the segment that contains the error from the given options.

Neither Smith / nor Rose / were in / the classroom.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the verb agreement with the subjects "**Neither Smith nor Rose**".
 
• The correct verb form should be "**was**", not "were", because "neither/nor" constructions take a singular verb.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Neither Smith nor Rose was in the classroom."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Neither Smith"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "the classroom"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "nor Rose"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
